auction.office_address: 201 Park Avenue, Room 300, Franklin, GA 30217 (mailing: P.O. Box 519, Franklin, GA 30217)
vital: The office posts a sale list PDF and spreadsheet on its page (most recently the 2025 Tax Sale List) showing parcel, address, defendant in fi. fa., years due and legal description. The list was revised as owners paid.
No venue, hours or bidder instructions are published online. Call the office to confirm them.

Georgia law sets sheriff and tax sales on the first Tuesday of the month between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm (O.C.G.A. 9-13-161). This county has not published its own venue or start time online, so confirm with the office before you go.
Georgia law: tax sales are buyer beware (O.C.G.A. 9-13-167) and the tax deed carries no warranty of title.

Georgia law: the owner or any lienholder may redeem for 12 months after the sale, and until the right to redeem is foreclosed, by paying the bid plus a 20% premium, plus 10% for each additional year (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45).
